courseCorrectionReceived.content: the five action_id strings are a server contract (400 on anything else); expiresAt is nullable and null means UNBOUNDED; use the route's asOf as the clock; the route fails loud so a 500 must stay distinct from not-built and from empty; both allowlist entries are entirely this lane's risk because legacy-design-tools has no allowlist of its own
courseCorrectionReceived.conflictWithDispatchOrDecision: NONE. The ids map one-to-one onto ladder v1 with no orphan rung and no orphan id. Every other point tightened the build rather than contradicting it.
applied: NEXT_ACTION_IDS is now an exported const array and NextActionId is DERIVED from it, so the list and the union cannot drift; all five renamed to the server's snake_case
AccountUnlock.expiresAt is string | null; null is kept as an active unbounded unlock, never dropped and never read as a date
UnlocksRead's read arm carries the server's asOf and the ladder has NO `now` field at all - the clock and the expiries arrive in one response so they cannot disagree
UnlocksRead gained an `error` arm so a 500 is distinct from not-built, blocked, unread and empty
parseAccountUnlocks REQUIRES a parseable asOf; its absence is an unreadable body, never a fallback to Date.now()
recordActivationEvent gained a `rejected` kind for 400, so a refused action_id is nameable rather than filed under network

adversarialFindingsAgainstMyOwnWork.fix: duration wording that rounds DOWN ('Less than a day left', 'About 3 days left'). Understating is the safe direction for a lapse warning.

violationBattery.method: each mutation applied to the FINAL source, the relevant suite run, the file restored from a pristine copy. A mutation whose pattern did not apply is reported as SKIP rather than counted as a pass - the first run of this harness silently no-op'd five mutations on a CRLF file and reported them green, which is why the harness now checks that the pattern was found before it trusts the result.
violationBattery.note: V9 fails the TYPE CHECKER rather than a test. Removing the null-expiry skip leaves `daysUntil(u.expiresAt, asOf)` receiving string | null, which is TS2345. That is the stronger mechanism, not a weaker one, but it is reported for what it is: vitest alone does not catch it, because Date.parse(null) happens to be NaN and the downstream unparseable guard absorbs it.

instrumentDefectFoundInMyOwnHarness.what: perl -0pi -e substitutions whose patterns contained \n silently failed on CRLF files, and the violation runs reported PASSING (i.e. 'the check is vacuous') when in fact no mutation had been made.
instrumentDefectFoundInMyOwnHarness.howCaught: the grep-count sanity line after each mutation did not move
instrumentDefectFoundInMyOwnHarness.fix: the harness now normalises the pattern to the file's own line endings and refuses to score a case whose pattern was not found
instrumentDefectFoundInMyOwnHarness.generalisation: a convenient result is a reason to distrust the instrument. Here the INconvenient result was the honest one and the instrument was producing it for the wrong reason.
